scope: Resolution of the 24-row triage table and three directly related source forms.
phonology: Compare Chinese rounded-vowel adaptation in the relevant Northern forms, and nasal-coda/nasal-vowel correspondences. These comparisons do not rewrite the source IPA. The Southern 麻烦 record ma¹³xua³³ has no nasalization mark in its original record.
limits: Specific donor varieties and borrowing dates remain unspecified where not established.
Only the reviewed borrowed syllables are covered in compounds.
The distinct original registered senses, including 弓 and 箭, remain unchanged.

decisions.basis: Reviewed lexical analysis allowing loan adaptation; source IPA, tone and registered sense retained. Comparison IDs refer to dictionary records, not additional donor-language recordings.
